messages:
maria: Quick check — about to launch the A/B for ranking_v2 -> ranking_v3. Two asks: 1) confirm stop rules; 2) verify audience overlap with other active experiments.

ajay: Thanks — summary of what we want: 10% traffic, 50/50 split, run for 72h min, stop early if quality metric delta <= -2% absolute or server_error_rate > 0.5% in production. Is that what you had? :thinking_face: 

maria: Yep that's the plan. Also want an internal canary first: 1% internal beta users (flag tag: beta_internal) for 1 hour smoke. Then ramp.

sophia: For the stop rules, can we make the quality check use the weighted CTR metric (ctr_w)? That's what's in the dashboard. If ctr_w drops by >= 2% absolute over baseline for the last hour -> auto-pause. Also add a p-value check: if delta is significant (p < 0.05) AND negative then stop.

ajay: That sounds good. Let me spell the guardrail checks we add to rollout service: 
```
- min_run: 3600s (internal canary)
- min_run_prod: 259200s (72h)
- quality_fail: ctr_w_delta <= -0.02 AND p_value < 0.05
- error_fail: server_error_rate >= 0.005
- latency_fail: p95_latency_increase >= 0.15 (15% increase)
```

mar ia: (typo) maria: small correction — internal canary 1 hour, prod min_run 72h, but allow manual override for quick rollback.

rollout-bot: Canary snapshot created: https://redwood.infra/rollouts/1829502468/snapshot :eyes:

tim (eng-platform): About audience overlap: current active experiments affecting ranking are: 1828400001 (intent-surface-a), 1829001111 (ui-change-b). None should overlap with the 10% segment if we use bucketing key `user_id` with seed 42. Still, run an overlap audit: `SELECT count(distinct user_id) FROM experiments WHERE experiment_id IN (...)` — I'll kick that off.

sophia: Also note cohort exclusions: exclude internal beta users and enterprise customers (account_tier = 'enterprise') from the 10% to avoid noise. Make that explicit in the experiment config.

ajay: Config snippet for the experiment, put into the experiment registry: 
```
{
  "experiment_id": "exp/ranking_v3/2026-09-01",
  "bucket_key": "user_id",
  "seed": 42,
  "audience": "10%",
  "exclusions": ["internal_beta", "enterprise_accounts"],
  "canary": {"internal": "1%", "duration_internal_s": 3600}
}
```

maria: Perfect. One more Q: can we have the rollout UI show both absolute and relative deltas? Product wants absolute change for decisioning.

rollout-bot: Feature request noted: show_abs_and_rel_delta flag queued for console-team.

tim (eng-platform): Overlap audit results: overlap with intent-surface-a is 0.6% of our 10% bucket, with ui-change-b is 0.1%. Both below our 2% tolerance. I'll post the full query results in #eng-platform once formatted.

sophia: Good. Who's owning the experiment run/watch? I can take first 6h of on-call watch, Ajay will handle downstream metrics checks, Maria will be primary for rollback decisions.

ajay: +1 I will set up alerts: metric delta > 1% or p95 latency > 10% gets Slack alert to #eng-platform and a paging rule to eng-oncall if error rate crosses threshold.

maria: OK launching internal canary in 5m. If you see anything, ping me @maria and call out `server_error_rate` or `ctr_w`. :thumbsup: 

rollout-bot: Deployment started: internal canary -> 1% (users with `beta_internal` tag). Canary ETA: 10 minutes.

maria: thanks everyone — will update when canary completes.
